0.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_001
0.description: There's nothing left to build now! Surely they could spare a paltry few minutes to come and collect these blasted things...

1.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_SYSTEM_000_005
1.description: Complete 100 stellar missions in Sinus Ardorum to become eligible to undertake an additional quest.

2.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_002
2.description: Good day to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Will you come and speak with me when you have a moment?

3.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_003
3.description: The Cosmic Exploration Initiative has barely taken its first steps. To truly blossom, it needs both your talents and your time!

4.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_004
4.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I'm so glad to see you. Will you come and speak with me when you have a moment?

5.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_006
5.description: I worry that other crew members may be in need of help but are too hesitant to ask for it. Might you keep an ear out for me?

6.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_007
6.description: Councilor Y'adebh's inspection couldn't have gone better. If I find another task in need of a measured approach, I shall be sure to come to you.

7.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_SYSTEM_000_008
7.description: Complete 50 stellar missions on Phaenna to become eligible to undertake an additional quest.

8.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_010
8.description: Ugh, it pains me to think of the tasks left unfinished back at the Hub... Is there <hex:021A020203>anyone<hex:021A020103> who might have a free moment?

9.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_SYSTEM_000_009
9.description: To undertake a new quest from Mumukko, you will need to complete her quests in Sinus Ardorum.

10.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_011
10.description: How are you faring, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? I could always use your assistance whenever you have some time.

11.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_012
11.description: Well, if it isn't the shining star who personally attended Councilor Y'adebh! I should like to speak with you again once your preparations are complete.

12.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_013
12.description: Do keep an eye out for fellow contributors in need of assistance. I'm sure they'd be grateful to avail themselves of your talents!

13.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_014
13.description: Your tireless efforts continue to amaze me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The initiative owes you a great deal indeed!

14.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_020
14.description: A pleasure to see you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I do hope you can lend a hand when you have a spare moment.

15.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_SYSTEM_000_015
15.description: Complete 50 stellar missions on Oizys to become eligible to undertake an additional quest.

16.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_016
16.description: I can't help but think of all the work still left to do on Phaenna... Surely someone out there can spare their precious time?

17.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_SYSTEM_000_017
17.description: To undertake a new quest from Mumukko, you will need to complete her quests on Phaenna.

18.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_018
18.description: I trust you are well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If you have the time, I would be grateful of your aid.

19.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_019
19.description: Thank you for assisting with my little survey. I wonder what the results might reveal?

20.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_030
20.description: Hello there, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You're not...busy with something, are you?

21.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_021
21.description: Do let me know how it goes with the dhalmels.

22.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_022
22.description: Dear me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, where are your tools?

23.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_024
23.description: You haven't forgotten about my request, I hope?

24.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_025
24.description: Thanks to you, my job is easier than ever. Ah, the bliss of a competent assistant manager!

25.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_026
25.description: Worry not, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I shan't trouble you, as I know you have full many a task on your plate already.

26.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_SYSTEM_000_027
26.description: Complete 50 stellar missions on Auxesia to become eligible to undertake an additional quest.

27.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_MUMUKKO_000_028
27.description: Are you headed back to Oizys by any chance? There are some few remaining tasks that want for idle hands...

28.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMUMUKKO_00956_SYSTEM_000_029
28.description: To undertake a new quest from Mumukko, you will need to complete her quests on Oizys.
